subject: Unexpected invoice uplift — usage telemetry and offset proposal
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos@edgewave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, EdgeWave Billing <billing@edgewave.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden +45% on March invoice — please advise

Hi Soojin,

We just opened March invoices and saw a ~45% uplift compared to our usual run rate. Attached is the invoice PDF plus a quick screenshot of our accounting dashboard. We didn't change usage patterns on our side and a few of our engineers validated that no large jobs ran in the time window.

Can you confirm whether this is expected and share the raw usage/telemetry for our account for 03/13–03/14? We need to reconcile this with our finance team by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Carlos Ruiz
Head of Platform
EdgeWave Inc.

Attachments: edgewave_invoice_mar2028.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos@edgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden +45% on March invoice — please advise

Carlos — thanks for flagging this and apologies for the stress. I pulled a quick look and we’re already investigating. Summary so far:

- What we saw: several customer sessions for your account were double-counted for a short window during a backend migration last night (approx 02:10–03:55 PT on 2028-03-14). That led to inflated token counts for affected requests.
- Impact: preliminary estimate is ~43–48% of the March 13–14 usage spike is anomalous. We’ll confirm a final number after we validate logs end-to-end.

Immediate next steps I’m initiating:
1) I’m attaching a telemetry bundle with request-level rows (timestamp, model, tokens_in/tokens_out, request_id) and a short note marking suspected duplicates — telemetry_bundle_20280314.zip.
2) I’ll coordinate with Finance to propose an offset for the anomalous portion; our working proposal is to credit the anomalous tokens + an additional goodwill credit equal to one week of average spend while we finish the audit.
3) We’ll produce an updated invoice and a one-line summary explaining the adjustment for your AP team.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll loop in Ben (billing) to finalize numbers and Laura (your account lead) to confirm external comms. I’ll also confirm whether any dashboards in your account were affected by the duplicate counts.

Apologies again — we’ll get this cleaned up quickly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

Attachments: telemetry_bundle_20280314.zip (CSV bundle, 3.2MB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos@edgewave.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sudden +45% on March invoice — propose credit / updated invoice (internal)

Ben/Laura — forwarding the thread. TL;DR: EdgeWave saw a ~45% unexpected uplift on their March invoice; preliminary root cause is a short KV/cache migration that caused duplicate token accounting for a ~1.75 hour window. I attached the telemetry bundle.

Proposal (please approve):
- Issue a credit equal to the anomalous delta (~$23,400) + goodwill credit of $5,000 (total $28,400).
- Provide an updated invoice PDF and a one-line explanation their AP can attach.
- Share the telemetry bundle and a short reconciliation table (we’ll mark rows we believe were double-counted).

Notes for finance/legal: we should record as an invoice adjustment. Ben, can you confirm this matches our standard adjustment approval below $50k? If not, I’ll escalate to Markus. Laura, confirm you’re ok with the wording and the goodwill amount.

For internal context: engineering (runtime team) traced the bug to a short-lived batch duplication during the migration; it did not affect model outputs, only metering. Engineering will provide a concise postmortem by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachments: telemetry_bundle_20280314.zip, offset_proposal_EW-47.pdf

From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos@edgewave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeWave Billing <billing@edgewave.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 16:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden +45% on March invoice — usage telemetry and offset proposal

Soojin — thanks for the quick response and for the telemetry bundle. We reviewed the CSV and the rows your team marked as duplicates line up with what our platform team observed.

EdgeWave accepts the proposed credit of $28,400. A couple of asks before we close the ticket:
- Please send the updated invoice PDF (with credit applied) and a short one-line description we can attach to our AP system.
- Can you confirm whether our billing dashboard and usage graphs will be adjusted retroactively or whether we should expect the raw dashboard to still show the spike? (We need the dashboard view to align with the corrected invoice for our internal audit.)

If you can send the invoice doc and note today we’ll process the adjustment. Thank you for handling this quickly.

Regards,
Carlos Ruiz
Head of Platform
EdgeWave Inc.

Attachments: none
